extraction_method: Direct column extraction. date = YYYY-MM-01 mapped to DD-MM-YYYY. Value preserved as source string (no rounding, no normalization).
notes: Mathematically derivable from y10_bm_cum + cpi via: real_return_t = (y10_bm_cum[t] / y10_bm_cum[t-1]) / (cpi[t] / cpi[t-1]) - 1
Max derivation difference vs source: 0.00015 (1.5 bp), explained by CPI rounding to 3 decimal places

NOT replaced by runtime derivation: cumulative-index and CPI runtime representations are rounded, so compounding over the historical period produces measurable index-level differences (0.054% bonds at 2016-09) that would break pinned oracle matrix comparisons
Retained as source-provided canonical output from ERN Google Sheet for exact replication
